segments.text: Kids born the day GTA 5 came out are teenagers now. That's how long we waited for GTA 6.
September 2013. GTA 5 launches, and becomes one of the best-selling games ever.
Then more than eight years of silence, until Rockstar confirms the next GTA in February 2022.

card.headline: Rockstar confirms the next GTA is coming

segments.text: December 2023. Trailer one sets a YouTube record: over ninety million views in a day.

card.headline: Trailer 1: 90M+ views in 24h — a YouTube record

segments.text: May 2025. The first delay, to May 2026. Days later, trailer two pulls four hundred seventy five million views in a day.
November 2025. Delay number two. New date: November 19, 2026.
And on November 19, 2026, it finally launched.
Thirteen years and two months. Worth the wait? Tell me below.

facts.claim: GTA V released September 17, 2013; one of the best-selling games of all time
Rockstar confirmed next GTA in active development on February 4, 2022
Trailer 1 (Dec 2023): 90,421,491 views in 24 hours — Guinness record for a non-music video debut
Delay #1 announced May 2, 2025: new date May 26, 2026
Trailer 2 (May 6, 2025): 475M views across platforms in 24 hours
Delay #2 announced November 6, 2025: new date November 19, 2026
Sep 17 2013 → Nov 19 2026 = 13 years 2 months; Sep 2013 → Feb 2022 = 8 years 4.5 months; a child born Sep 17 2013 is 13

metadata.title: GTA 6 Is Finally Out — After 13 Years of Waiting
metadata.description:
From GTA 5 in 2013 to GTA 6 on November 19, 2026: the reveal, two record-breaking trailers and two delays — the whole 13-year wait in under a minute. Worth it?
